paraphrase: Māyā, one and eternal, is the material cause from which the impure principles arise — kalā, vidyā, rāga, kāla, niyati, then the prakṛti with its guṇas, buddhi, ahaṅkāra, mind, the senses, the subtle and gross elements — as the soul's instruments and objects; above māyā lie the pure principles of the pure universe.
notes: Whole-work reference; order of evolutes moderate confidence.
